GBM test6: monochrome payment, home and sign-in redesign; order overflow and text contrast fixes; order-based package details; disable duplicate payment while activation is pending; defer home initialization until sign-in.

Android 5.5.8 (50508), internal debug-signed test build. Same certificate as test4/test5 for in-place upgrade. 45 client tests passed; no analyze errors or warnings. Funded payment and VPN end-to-end were not verified in this UI acceptance. Windows is packaged separately.
